warnings: TWO PVC PRESSURE CLASSES ARE USED AND THE SPLIT IS DELIBERATE: ชั้น 13.5 for the pressurised cold-water supply, ชั้น 8.5 for the gravity soil, waste and vent lines. Recorded per pipe type rather than as one project-wide material.

BOTH GRAVITY LINES CARRY A MINIMUM FALL OF 1:75 (ลาดเอียงไม่น้อยกว่า 1:75). Note this is a different figure from the 1:200 printed on the ท่อ AC perimeter drain on the plan and the 1:200 floor falls in the bathrooms - three different slopes for three different things, all recorded where they are printed.
The vent line has no slope requirement, correctly, and none was invented for it.
